title: Airy Turning-Point Asymptotics for Ramanujan's Entire Function $A_q(z)$
summary: Let $$ A_q(z)=\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\frac{q^{k^2}}{(q;q)_k}(-z)^k $$ be Ramanujan's entire function. We study it in the turning-point scaling $$ q=e^{-\varepsilon},\qquad z=\frac{\sqrt q}{4}e^{-\varepsilon^{2/3}ζ}, $$ with $ζ$ in a compact subset of $\mathbb{C}$.
